snippet.title: Want More Than Blocks? 🐻 Play VOIMA #Trailer
snippet.description:
VOIMA is a new sandbox game that redefines creative building. 🛠️ Survive, mod, and build with powerful tools in this early access experience! Try it today 👇

🎮 PLAY THE GAME ➡ https://voima.gg

📢 JOIN OUR COMMUNITY:
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/voima
📸 Instagram (Game): https://www.instagram.com/voima.game/
👨‍💻 Instagram (Creator): https://www.instagram.com/ilovevaltsu/
🎥 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@voima.game

☕ Support development: https://ko-fi.com/voima

---

🧱 What is VOIMA?
VOIMA is an immersive sandbox game focused on creativity and player freedom. Still in early alpha, it's already loaded with unique features like:
- Precise block cutting tools
- Modding support (new characters, blocks, weapons & more!)
- A world editor with full control
- Portal and mirror mechanics
- Parkour and combat systems
- Survival + tower defense modes in development
- Creatures like Jawns and Bears 🐻

🛠️ Everything you see is made by a solo developer working full-time to bring VOIMA to life.

---

🎙️ Credits:
Narration – Dominic Stocker  
Music – https://youtube.com/@UCXSGNzSmHD33xJYsd3AkCgg  
Audio Mixing – https://www.instagram.com/phonkmatej/

---

0:21 - Worlds  
0:40 - Combat  
1:00 - Parkour
